dialogue.title: Starting Grunts
body: These grunts are your first worker units.
They can fight in a pinch, but their most important job is harvesting resources and keeping the base alive.

dialogue.title: The Core
body: This is the Core. It powers your arcane network and anchors the run.
If every Core falls, the run is lost.

dialogue.title: The House
body: Houses provide troop supply.
Build more housing when you want a larger army or more workers.

dialogue.title: Mineral Extractor
body: This extractor claims a nearby mineral deposit.
Workers gather from claimed deposits and haul resources back to the Core.

dialogue.title: Minerals
body: Minerals are the secondary construction resource.
Most towers and advanced structures need minerals as well as gold.

dialogue.title: Select Workers
body: Left click a grunt, or drag a box around several grunts, to select workers.

dialogue.title: Assign Workers
body: With grunts selected, right click near the extractor to set their station.
Workers stationed near a connected deposit will gather automatically.

objective.title: Assign Workers
objective.description: Station a grunt near the starting extractor.

objective.title: Watch Minerals Move
objective.description: Let a grunt complete one mineral delivery.

objective.title: Watch The Attack
objective.description: Enemies are closing on the Core.

dialogue.title: Defend The Base
body: The Core just took damage. Build 3 Archer Towers before the attack gets worse.
Do not protect only the Core. Resource buildings are vulnerable too, so place at least one Archer Tower near the mineral extractor.

objective.title: Build Archer Towers
objective.description: Build 3 Archer Towers. At least 1 must defend the starting extractor.

objective.title: Watch Towers Fire
objective.description: Let your Archer Towers destroy the tutorial enemies.

dialogue.title: Barracks
body: A Barracks produces troops for defense, exploration, and resource work.
Build one now.

dialogue.title: Train A Grunt
body: Troops are trained from the Barracks.
Train 1 Grunt. For now, focus on learning production rather than every troop type.

objective.title: Train 1 Grunt
objective.description: Queue and complete one Grunt at a Barracks.

dialogue.title: Explore
body: The world contains discoverable resources beyond the starting base.
Gold deposits fund building, troop training, research, and long-term growth.

dialogue.title: Map And Movement
body: Use WASD, arrow keys, middle mouse drag, or the map to move the camera.
Select troops and right click into the fog to send them exploring. The pulsing marker on the map points toward a gold deposit.

objective.title: Discover Gold
objective.description: Move troops close enough to reveal the marked gold deposit.

dialogue.title: Claim Gold
body: Build an extractor on the gold deposit.
Gold extractors work like mineral extractors, but they add gold to your stockpile.

objective.title: Claim Gold Deposit
objective.description: Build an extractor on a gold deposit.

objective.title: Assign Gold Worker
objective.description: Station a grunt near the gold extractor.

objective.title: Watch Gold Move
objective.description: Let a grunt complete one gold delivery.

dialogue.title: Research Lab
body: Advanced buildings unlock deeper progression once your economy is running.
Build a Research Lab.

dialogue.title: Research
body: Research Labs run timed upgrades.
Research can improve towers, troops, worker output, and production speed over the course of a run.

dialogue.title: Library
body: Libraries introduce item production.
Build a Library to unlock scrolls and begin learning the item layer.

dialogue.title: Items
body: Items are run tools that add temporary power, utility, or troop equipment.
The Library is your first entry point into that system.

dialogue.title: Hero Hall
body: The Hero Hall introduces hero progression and troop growth.
Build one to finish the guided setup.

dialogue.title: Hero Progression
body: Hero Halls unlock hero usage, troop leveling, and the level-up menu.
That is the guided path complete. When you press Next, this same run continues as a normal run.
